newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union up on bid talk, switching.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union up on bid talk, switching.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union jumped on Thursday as vague bid speculation sparked early buying, traders said.
The shares spiked up to 647p shortly after the start of trading before easing back to 641-1/2p, a gain of 15-1/2p on the day.
Switching into the stock from others in the insurance sector was also said to be helping Commercial Union.
Dealers were cautious about talk of a bid but said the possibilty of a merger in the current round of industry consolidation could not be ruled out.
"People occasionally dust off these rumours and if the market feels something is going on it will charge in," said one dealer.
Another dealer said there were strong rumours of continuing bid and rationalisation activity in the sector.
A spokesman for Commercial Union said the company never commented on market speculation.
Presentations on the group's French operations at the end of September were also said to have been well received by analysts.
